dict.string: OmniBar uses Automation to move files in Finder, send items to the Trash and open Terminal commands when you ask for Homebrew actions.
OmniBar uses each app's audio to adjust its volume in the mixer and to include the Mac's sound in the screen recordings you start. Nothing leaves your Mac.
OmniBar uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
OmniBar records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
OmniBar shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
OmniBar checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose.
OmniBar organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose.
